other_failure_modes.name: Target Encoding Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies target encoding to the training set by computing target statistics on the whole training set and mapping them directly back, without using out-of-fold (OOF) techniques. This causes target leakage where the sample's own label contributes to its feature value, leading to severe overfitting in powerful models like gradient boosted trees.

summary: The agent implements a generally well-structured pipeline using tree-based models and validation-weighted ensembling. However, the solution suffers from a critical data leakage flaw by applying target encoding directly to the full training set without out-of-fold predictions. It also lacks feature engineering and relies on a single validation split for evaluation.
